explanation: The nonce check in verify rejects tokens whose nonce is already in seen. Removing it would allow replay attacks. #123 is an issue reference for this hazard.
Call ensure_key_salt before initializing KeyManager. If salt setup fails, startup must abort rather than continue with the manager.
Before allocating buf with topN elements, topN must be no greater than maxSimpleTopN, and the resulting slice must be at most 1 MiB.
If meta.abi_version is absent, this mapping must produce None rather than substitute the current ABI. #1784 is an issue reference for that hazard.

The external TLP configuration file /etc/tlp.conf is read after drop-ins such as /etc/tlp.d/90-power.conf, so a value there overrides the value written by this call. /etc/tlp.d/*.conf refers to all drop-in configuration files.

The configuration written here requires TLP version 1.10 or later. _AC, _BAT and _SAV are TLP profile suffixes; the key being set is for the battery profile. Leaving the _AC setting unset preserves GNOME’s Performance toggle.
When JSON parsing fails, return null so the caller can log a warning instead of throwing the parse error from this catch block.

When AllowedTools is set, RemoveSkipPermissions must remove --dangerously-skip-permissions from the arguments because that flag bypasses --allowedTools. AllowedTools is the configured tool restriction; the two flag names identify the conflicting command-line options.

For the verdict table relevant to thunk_is_dead, consult the is_definitely_dead_code symbol in rust/xray-core/src/compiler/graph_preamble.rs. The path identifies the file and the text after the colon identifies the symbol.
unsure: The comment does not identify which verdict table or specify its entries.

explanation: Replace the hard-coded repos_skipped value with one derived from the domains-to-repos mapping. #874 is the issue tracking that work.
The index.regex_query call uses a linear-time DFA for regex matching, avoiding backtracking. This records the performance property expected of this query.

Keep the token-family table schema in this SQL definition consistent with RefreshTokenSqliteBackend._ensure_schema in src/storage/refresh_token_backend.py. The path names the Python file and the suffix names the class method.
The vendor’s batch API accepts at most 500 items, which is why MAX_BATCH is 500. doc:vendor-api#limits points to the limits section of the vendor API documentation.

Keep these Status values in sync with STATUS_LABELS in web/src/status.ts. Reordering the iota constants would change what already stored integer values mean. #88 is an issue reference for that hazard.
The index must list tenant_id before created_at to match the orders_by_tenant query. orders_by_tenant names the query whose column order this index supports.
TList.Add must maintain FCount at or below Length(FItems). Grow is the operation that preserves this capacity invariant.
In close, flush before closing the sink: closing it drops _buf, so reversing the calls could lose buffered data.
Because userPath comes from a request, resolve it under workspaceRoot and reject paths containing .. that escape that root. The target assignment is part of that path handling.
unsure: The snippet shows resolution and normalization but does not show the required escape check.

explanation: Drain the ring before freeing buf. Freeing buf first could leave the interrupt handler using freed memory. #2201 is an issue reference for this hazard.

Reserve capacity for n items before adding them so allocation happens once; prior push_back growth accounted for 40% of the measured profile. doc:perf-notes#ingest points to the ingest section of the performance notes.
Use HOLDLOCK on this SQL Server MERGE because otherwise concurrent upserts can race. doc:mssql-merge#concurrency points to the concurrency section of the MERGE documentation.
The audit operation uses an autonomous transaction so its row survives a rollback of the caller’s transaction. Using the caller’s transaction would roll back that row too.

This migration creates a replacement table because SQLite ALTER TABLE cannot drop the needed constraints directly. doc:sqlite-alter#otheralter points to the relevant ALTER TABLE documentation section.
The loop polls every five seconds because NFS mounts do not emit the inotify events this code would need to detect changes. The 5 in done.wait(5) is the polling interval.
Keep the awaited run calls in a for...of loop. Awaiting inside forEach would let asynchronous errors escape the surrounding try/catch.
Every Vec<u8> frame returned by read_frame must have length no greater than MAX_FRAME; the decoder is responsible for rejecting larger frames.
Register drainHook before pool.start() so the pool has a shutdown hook from the time it starts. That hook drains the pool when SIGTERM arrives.

Move the hard-coded retry delay into configuration. The task is complete when Default in internal/retry/policy.go reads that configuration; the path identifies the file and Default identifies the symbol.
Issue #412 contains the full matrix of transitions among LeaseState values, including Active, Released and Stale.
Pass the token to tool login only through standard input. Putting it in command-line arguments would expose it through ps, which shows arguments to other users.
Create the app_reader role before granting it SELECT access. Migration 042 assumes that role exists; 042 identifies the dependent migration.
Make on_event idempotent because Stripe may retry the same webhook for three days. doc:stripe#webhook-retries points to documentation for Stripe’s webhook retry behavior.
Compare the received and expected MACs with hmac.Equal, which is constant-time, because comparing them with == could reveal information through timing.
Build CodeGraph once per index, at a cost proportional to the number of edges. Do not rebuild it for each query.
The packed TCustomerRec layout is used by saved .dat files. Changing that layout would make existing files incompatible, so bump FILE_VERSION when doing so.
Change MSG_MAX together with MSG_MAX_WIRE in proto/messages.h so the two limits stay consistent. The path identifies the header and the suffix identifies its constant.
When handler runs after authMiddleware, session.userId must be non-null. authMiddleware names the middleware that establishes this invariant.
Synchronize on cache because the check followed by insertion must be one atomic operation. The comment says a ConcurrentHashMap alone would not provide that behavior for this sequence.
Because raw contains a user-provided repository alias, validate it against the registry before using the alias in a path join. #1996 is an issue reference for this security requirement.
Payment Amount must be nonnegative for this insert. Refunds are represented as separate rows whose Kind is 'R', rather than as negative Amount values.
Set the stop flag before joining the worker. Otherwise the worker may keep running and worker_.join() may block forever.
The limiter is intended to respect GitHub’s external limit of 5,000 API requests per hour per token. doc:github-rest#rate-limits points to the REST API rate-limit documentation.
Stop the cidx service before replacing its binary at /usr/local/bin/cidx. An executing binary could cause the install step to fail with “Text file busy.”
Do not share this CredentialLease instance across jobs: credentials could then leak between users. #77 is an issue reference for that hazard.
Keep ids to at most 999 elements when building this DELETE statement, because each ID consumes a SQLite bound variable and the stated per-statement limit is 999.
If cgroup.create fails because of the containment setup, log the error and continue so the job survives a bad memory estimate. Do not abort the job on that failure.
unsure: The comment does not specify whether every cgroup.create failure should be treated this way or only a failure caused by a bad memory estimate.

explanation: Remove the legacy /v1/jobs route. #530 is the issue tracking that removal.
Consult the session-model section of ADR 007 for the reason SessionRegistry uses sessions per tab. doc:adr-007#session-model is the document anchor.
This partial index includes only leases with released_at IS NULL, supporting active-lease lookups by credential_id. The comment reports those lookups as 30 times faster.
Keep EVENT_TYPES consistent with EVENT_LABELS in web/src/events.ts and with docs/events.md. The first path names a TypeScript symbol; the second names the documentation file.

Sweep must not evict a bucket solely because it has been idle longer than IdleTTL. It also checks b.fullAt so a bucket that has not yet refilled cannot be recreated with a full allowance too early. TestSweepKeepsBucketsThatWouldNotBeFullYet names the test for this case.

Treat tokens within eps of 1 as sufficient for a request. Fractional refill calculations can drift just below 1, so requiring an exact 1 would wrongly deny a request. TestFractionalRefillIsPreservedAcrossRequests names the test for this behavior.

The result of insert.get is cast through unknown to TransferRow because this INSERT RETURNING operation is expected to return exactly one row. The comment gives that guarantee as the reason for the double cast instead of a null check.
After opening the database, query sqlite_schema to force a schema read. The preceding PRAGMA statements do not read the database file, while the schema query rejects a file that is not a database.

Keep the guarded set_int_max_str_digits(0) call. On CPython 3.9.14 and later, removing it can cause ValueError when handling integers beyond 4,300 digits; hasattr checks whether that Python runtime provides the function.
Keep the 'equity' account name in the trigger consistent with EQUITY_ACCOUNT in src/ledger.ts. The path identifies the TypeScript file and the suffix identifies the symbol defining that account name.
Check isApplied again inside the write transaction before executing a migration. Another migrator might apply it after the earlier pending scan; the second check prevents applying it twice.
Keep set_int_max_str_digits(0) before printing fib(n). Without it, converting an integer longer than 4,300 digits to a string can raise ValueError.
For attempts greater than zero, backoff must return a delay no greater than maxBackoff. The first try has no waiting delay.
unsure: The comment does not define which attempt number represents the first try.
